from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/app/data/layout.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)
S=8
def trace(name,box,fg,bg=None,bgrow=None,circle=None,eps=0.35,thr=0.5,minarea=1.5):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=box
    crop=im[y0:y1,x0:x1]

        bgc=np.tile(im[bgrow,x0:x1][None],(y1-y0,1,1))
    else:
        bgc=np.zeros_like(crop)+np.array(bg,float)
    fgc=np.array(fg,float)
    d=bgc-fgc
    t=((bgc-crop)*d).sum(2)/np.maximum((d*d).sum(2),1)
    t=np.clip(t,0,1)
    if circle:
        cx,cy,r=circle
        yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]; t[((xx+.5-cx)**2+(yy+.5-cy)**2)>r*r]=0
    big=cv2.resize(t.astype(np.float32),None,fx=S,fy=S,interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
    m=(big>thr).astype(np.uint8)*255
    cs,h=cv2.findContours(m,cv2.RETR_CCOMP,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
